answer.rationale: Run a guarded SMB onboarding simplification test to accelerate time-to-value and reinforce product value without matching the competitor's price cut. Shortened onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, adoption, and 30-day retention. Activation messaging can support the test. Avoid promotional pricing because it previously lifted acquisition but materially harmed 30-day retention, conflicting with sustainable qualified revenue. Monitor churn, qualified revenue, and retention before expanding.
